q: أَنْتُنَّ ___ الْمَالَ لِلْفُقَرَاءِ فِي الشَّهْرِ الْمَاضِي.
e: You collected money for the poor last month.
They welcomed the guests at the airport yesterday.
The two policemen stood in front of the door for an hour yesterday.
The two girls memorised the poem last week.

q: أَنْتُمَا ___ الْأَثَاثَ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ الْجَدِيدِ أَمْسِ.
e: You two moved the furniture to the new house yesterday.
The boy admitted his mistake in front of everyone yesterday.

q: ___ زَمِيلَتِي فِكْرَةً جَدِيدَةً فِي الِاجْتِمَاعِ أَمْسِ.
e: My colleague suggested a new idea at the meeting yesterday.

q: نَحْنُ ___ الْمَطَرَ أَمْسِ، لٰكِنَّ الْجَوَّ كَانَ جَمِيلًا.
e: We expected rain yesterday, but the weather was lovely.
The staff dealt with the problem quickly yesterday.

q: أَنَا ___ كَثِيرًا مِنْ نَصِيحَتِكَ فِي السَّنَةِ الْمَاضِيَةِ.
e: I benefited a lot from your advice last year.
You discussed the plan at yesterday's meeting.

q: أَنْتُنَّ ___ الْأَلَمَ بِصَبْرٍ فِي الْأُسْبُوعِ الْمَاضِي.
e: You bore the pain patiently last week.
You avoided the traffic yesterday morning.

q: ___ الْمُسَافِرُ خَطَأَهُ بَعْدَ أَنْ أَقْلَعَتِ الطَّائِرَةُ.
e: The traveller realised his mistake after the plane had taken off.

q: الْمُعَلِّمَاتُ ___ تَغَيُّرًا فِي سُلُوكِهِ فِي الشَّهْرِ الْمَاضِي.
e: The teachers noticed a change in his behaviour last month.

q: الْعُلَمَاءُ ___ نَوْعًا جَدِيدًا مِنَ السَّمَكِ فِي السَّنَةِ الْمَاضِيَةِ.
e: Scientists discovered a new kind of fish last year.
The news spread quickly yesterday.

q: أَنْتُنَّ ___ عَلَى الِاقْتِرَاحِ فِي الِاجْتِمَاعِ الْمَاضِي.
e: You agreed to the proposal at the last meeting.
The two ministers rejected the plan last week.
I apologised to him for the delay yesterday.

q: ___ أُخْتِي مِنَ الْجَامِعَةِ فِي السَّنَةِ الْمَاضِيَةِ.
e: My sister graduated from university last year.

q: الْمُدِيرَتَانِ ___ الْمَشْرُوعَ نَاجِحًا فِي الشَّهْرِ الْمَاضِي.
e: The two directors (f) considered the project a success last month.

q: أَنْتَ ___ هٰذَا الْبَرْنَامَجَ فِي السَّنَةِ الْمَاضِيَةِ.
e: You developed this program last year.

q: أَنْتُمَا ___ عَنْ رَأْيِكُمَا بِوُضُوحٍ فِي الِاجْتِمَاعِ أَمْسِ.
e: You two expressed your opinion clearly at the meeting yesterday.
